chapterInfo.content:
19
Tenenee hia
1 # Mmb 28.6 Ohiani a ɔnam ne pɛyɛ mu yɛ
sene deɛ ɔkyea n’anomu nsɛm na ɔyɛ kwasea.
2Ɔkra a nimdeɛ abɔ no nyɛ,
na deɛ ne nan ase yɛ herɛ no yɛ bɔne.
3 # Kwa 3.39 Onipa agyimisɛm kyinkyim ne kwan,
na n’akoma huri tia AWURADE.
4 # Mmb 14.20 Ahonya ma obi nya nnamfo pii,
na mmɔborɔni ne ne yɔnko ntam tete.
5 # Mmb 19.9; 21.28; Deut 19.18-21 Ɔdansekurumfoɔ ho renyɛ tɔtorɔtɔɔ,
na deɛ ɔhu atorosɛm no rennya adwaneyɛ.
6Nnipa pii dɛfɛdɛfɛ ɔdɛɛfoɔ,
na nnipa nyinaa yɛ ɔyamyiefoɔ nnamfo.
7 # Mmb 19.4 Ohiani nuanom nyinaa tane no,
na nkantom sɛ ne nnamfonom ne ne ntam rentwe,
ɔde nsɛm ti wɔn a, ɔnto wɔn.
8Deɛ ɔnya nyansa no dɔ ne kra,
deɛ ɔbu nhunumu no, ɔhunu papa.
9 # Mmb 19.5 Ɔdansekurumfoɔ ho renyɛ tɔtorɔtɔɔ,
na deɛ ɔhu atorosɛm no bɛyera.
10Taamudie mfata ɔkwasea,
na mprɛ ahe na akoa bɛdi mpanimfoɔ soɔ.
11Onipa nimdeɛ twentwɛn n’abufuo ase,
na mfomsoɔ ho twa yɛ no animuonyam.
12 # Mmb 20.2; 16.14-15 Ɔhene abufuo te sɛ gyata mmobom,
na n’anisɔ te sɛ wira so bosuo.
13 # Mmb 10.1 Ɔba kwasea yɛ n’agya mmusuo,
na ɔbaa ntɔkwako yɛ daa nsuo a ɛsosɔ.
14 # Mmb 18.22 Efie ne ahodeɛ yɛ agyanom awunnyadeɛ,
na ɔyere nimdefoɔ firi AWURADE.
15 # Mmb 10.4; 23.21 Aniha yɛ nnahɔɔ,
na onipa kwadwofoɔ bɛdi kɔm.
16 # Mmb 16.17 Deɛ ɔkora mmara asɛm no kora ne kra,
na deɛ ɔnhwɛ n’akwan yie no bɛwu.
17 # Mmb 14.31; Dwom 41.1-3; Mat 25.40 Deɛ ɔhunu mmɔborɔni mmɔborɔ de fɛm AWURADE,
na deɛ ɔde ama no, ɔbɛhyɛ no ananmu.
18 # Efe 6.4 Anidasoɔ wɔ hɔ yi, tea wo ba,
na mmɔ wo tirim sɛ wobɛku no.
19Deɛ n’abufuo so no bɛnya asotwe,
na sɛ wogyaa no a, wobɛsane agyaa no bio.
20Tie afotuo na gye atenetene,
na woahunu nyansa w’akyirinna mu.
21 # Mmb 16.9; Yer 10.23 Adwene pii wɔ onipa akoma mu,
nanso AWURADE agyinatuo na ɛbɛgyina.
22Onipa adɔeɛyɛ na ɛma wɔdɔ no,
na ohiani yɛ sene ɔtorofoɔ.
23 # Mmb 14.27 AWURADE suro de obi kɔ nkwa mu,
deɛ ɔkura mu no bɛmee ada, na bɔne biara renka no.
24 # Mmb 26.15 Ɔkwadwofoɔ de ne nsa to ayowa mu,
na ɔnsane mfa nkɔ n’anomu mpo.
25 # Mmb 21.11 Bɔ ɔfɛdifoɔ, na atetekwaa ani bɛte,
na ka nhunumufoɔ anim, na wahunu nimdeɛ mu.
26Deɛ ɔbɔ n’agya atirimuɔden na ɔpamo ne na no
yɛ aniwuo ne ahohora ba.
27 # Yak 1.22 Me ba, wogyae atenetene tie a,
wobɛfom afiri nimdeɛ nsɛm ho bio.
28Ɔdansehuhuni di atemmuo ho fɛw,
na abɔnefoɔ ano mene mmusuo.
29 # Mmb 26.3 Wɔasiesie atemmuo ama afɛdifoɔ
ne mmaabɔ ama nkwaseafoɔ akyi.

pageProps.chapterText:
Ohiani a ɔnam ne pɛyɛ mu yɛ
sene deɛ ɔkyea n’anomu nsɛm na ɔyɛ kwasea.
Ɔkra a nimdeɛ abɔ no nyɛ,
na deɛ ne nan ase yɛ herɛ no yɛ bɔne.
Onipa agyimisɛm kyinkyim ne kwan,
na n’akoma huri tia AWURADE.
Ahonya ma obi nya nnamfo pii,
na mmɔborɔni ne ne yɔnko ntam tete.
Ɔdansekurumfoɔ ho renyɛ tɔtorɔtɔɔ,
na deɛ ɔhu atorosɛm no rennya adwaneyɛ.
Nnipa pii dɛfɛdɛfɛ ɔdɛɛfoɔ,
na nnipa nyinaa yɛ ɔyamyiefoɔ nnamfo.
Ohiani nuanom nyinaa tane no,
na nkantom sɛ ne nnamfonom ne ne ntam rentwe,
ɔde nsɛm ti wɔn a, ɔnto wɔn.
Deɛ ɔnya nyansa no dɔ ne kra,
deɛ ɔbu nhunumu no, ɔhunu papa.
Ɔdansekurumfoɔ ho renyɛ tɔtorɔtɔɔ,
na deɛ ɔhu atorosɛm no bɛyera.
Taamudie mfata ɔkwasea,
na mprɛ ahe na akoa bɛdi mpanimfoɔ soɔ.
Onipa nimdeɛ twentwɛn n’abufuo ase,
na mfomsoɔ ho twa yɛ no animuonyam.
Ɔhene abufuo te sɛ gyata mmobom,
na n’anisɔ te sɛ wira so bosuo.
Ɔba kwasea yɛ n’agya mmusuo,
na ɔbaa ntɔkwako yɛ daa nsuo a ɛsosɔ.
Efie ne ahodeɛ yɛ agyanom awunnyadeɛ,
na ɔyere nimdefoɔ firi AWURADE.
Aniha yɛ nnahɔɔ,
na onipa kwadwofoɔ bɛdi kɔm.
Deɛ ɔkora mmara asɛm no kora ne kra,
na deɛ ɔnhwɛ n’akwan yie no bɛwu.
Deɛ ɔhunu mmɔborɔni mmɔborɔ de fɛm AWURADE,
na deɛ ɔde ama no, ɔbɛhyɛ no ananmu.
Anidasoɔ wɔ hɔ yi, tea wo ba,
na mmɔ wo tirim sɛ wobɛku no.
Deɛ n’abufuo so no bɛnya asotwe,
na sɛ wogyaa no a, wobɛsane agyaa no bio.
Tie afotuo na gye atenetene,
na woahunu nyansa w’akyirinna mu.
Adwene pii wɔ onipa akoma mu,
nanso AWURADE agyinatuo na ɛbɛgyina.
Onipa adɔeɛyɛ na ɛma wɔdɔ no,
na ohiani yɛ sene ɔtorofoɔ.
AWURADE suro de obi kɔ nkwa mu,
deɛ ɔkura mu no bɛmee ada, na bɔne biara renka no.
Ɔkwadwofoɔ de ne nsa to ayowa mu,
na ɔnsane mfa nkɔ n’anomu mpo.
Bɔ ɔfɛdifoɔ, na atetekwaa ani bɛte,
na ka nhunumufoɔ anim, na wahunu nimdeɛ mu.
Deɛ ɔbɔ n’agya atirimuɔden na ɔpamo ne na no
yɛ aniwuo ne ahohora ba.
Me ba, wogyae atenetene tie a,
wobɛfom afiri nimdeɛ nsɛm ho bio.
Ɔdansehuhuni di atemmuo ho fɛw,
na abɔnefoɔ ano mene mmusuo.
Wɔasiesie atemmuo ama afɛdifoɔ
ne mmaabɔ ama nkwaseafoɔ akyi.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
